groups.problem: AccessTokenContext constructor checks grantType twice with requireNonNull and never checks rawTokenId.
groups.rationale: All five point at line 73 checking grantType instead of rawTokenId, and all give the same fix.

groups.problem: The isAccessTokenId matcher's grant-shortcut check is broken: it uses substring(3,5) instead of (4,6) and/or inverts the equals condition.
groups.rationale: All target the same one-line grant check in isAccessTokenId and are fixed by rewriting that line. Some mention only the offset or only the inversion, but a single edit fixes both.

groups.problem: encodeTokenId throws IllegalStateException for an unknown grant type or session type, which aborts token issuance in TokenManager.initToken instead of falling back.
groups.rationale: Both describe token issuance failing with a 500 when the encoder throws, and both propose falling back to UNKNOWN.

problems: The Context constructor calls formParams.getFirst without a null check, so a null formParams causes an NPE.
Removing the Context(Context) copy constructor breaks backward compatibility.
